title: EU Digital Markets Act enforcement targets Apple App Store game distribution rules
content: The European Commission has opened formal proceedings against Apple under the Digital Markets Act, specifically targeting App Store rules that restrict alternative payment processors and third-party app distribution for games. The investigation focuses on Apple's 'core technology fee' of €0.50 per install after 1 million downloads, which the Commission argues effectively nullifies the DMA's intent. Apple faces fines of up to 10% of global annual turnover if found in violation. Multiple major mobile game publishers including Supercell, King, and Playtika have submitted testimony supporting the Commission's case. Analysts expect a final ruling by Q4 2026, with significant implications for mobile game monetization globally.
